newsitem.title: CHINA: China Construction Bank issues $200 mln FRN in HK.
newsitem.headline: China Construction Bank issues $200 mln FRN in HK.

text.p: The China Construction Bank is to launch a $200 million floating rate note issue in bond-style in Hong Kong on Friday, the China Daily newspaper said.
The five-year notes carried a coupon of 30 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) and the all-in cost was 37.5 basis points over LIBOR, the official newspaper said.
The bonds will be listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on April 14 and were rated Baa1 by Moody's Investors Service, it said.

The bank would invest funds from the issue in eight large projects in China, including a 300,000 tonne ethylene plant in Maoming in southern Guangdong province and the Yangcheng Power Station in northern Shanxi province, it said.
Sources have said Daiwa Securities, Merrill Lynch Far East, Bayerisch Landesbank Hong Kong and Sakura Finance Asia will lead the deal.
